borrowConsent.title: Borrowing risk notice
borrowConsent.intro: Before you start borrowing, please review the following.
borrowConsent.b1: If your collateral (cbBTC) price falls, your position can be liquidated, causing a loss.
borrowConsent.b2: After borrowing, regularly check the health and liquidation price shown on screen.
borrowConsent.b3: Borrowing more conservatively (less) lowers your liquidation risk.
borrowConsent.b4: This app sends no alerts. Managing your position is entirely your responsibility.

swapGuide.title: About Swap

intro.title: What is this?
intro.body: Swap cbBTC ↔ SOL instantly at the best market route via the Jupiter aggregator.

how.title: How does it work?
how.body: Enter an input token and Jupiter compares routes across many DEXs to find the most favorable one.
how.b1: Solana's largest aggregator finds the best route automatically
how.b2: Preview the amount you'll receive and the price impact in a quote
how.b3: Runs only after you sign it with your Seed Vault

slippage.title: What is slippage?
slippage.body: The tolerance for how much the execution price may differ from the quote. Pick 0.1% / 0.5% / 1%.
slippage.b1: Higher in volatile markets, lower when stable
slippage.b2: Too low and the trade can fail if the price moves

safe.title: You stay in control
safe.b1: This app never holds your funds or keys (self-custody).
safe.b2: Every transaction is publicly recorded on Solana — verify on Explorer.
safe.b3: No backend servers, no analytics, no trackers.
safe.b4: Always keep a little SOL for fees (gas).

swapGuide.infographic: How swap works: your wallet → Jupiter compares routes → best route to the token you receive

lendingGuide.title: About cbBTC Lending

intro.title: What is this?
intro.body: When you supply cbBTC to Kamino, it's put to work in Solana's BTCfi ecosystem. Like a bank deposit, you leave it in and can withdraw it yourself anytime.

safe.title: You stay in control — self-custody
safe.b1: This app never holds your cbBTC or your private keys.
safe.b2: Funds are managed directly by Kamino's audited smart contracts.
safe.b3: Every transaction runs only after you sign it with your Seed Vault.
safe.b4: You can withdraw your supplied cbBTC yourself at any time.

example.title: A simple example
example.body: E.g. supply 0.001 cbBTC and it shows up under 'My position'. The cbBTC is still yours — tap 'Withdraw' to take it back anytime, just like withdrawing a deposit.

withdrawSection.title: Withdraw (take it back anytime)
withdrawSection.body: Your supplied cbBTC is yours. Tap 'Withdraw' to take all or part of it back to your wallet anytime.
withdrawSection.b1: Withdraw everything with MAX, or just a portion you choose.
withdrawSection.b2: If you have borrowing, your withdrawable amount may be limited to keep enough collateral.
withdrawSection.b3: Withdrawing sends cbBTC straight back to your wallet.

transparency.title: It works transparently
transparency.b1: Every transaction is publicly recorded on the Solana blockchain — verify it yourself on Explorer.
transparency.b2: There is no backend server. The app does not collect your data.
transparency.b3: The source code is open on GitHub.
transparency.b4: Each transaction is simulated and checked before you sign.

borrow.title: Borrowing against collateral
borrow.body: You can borrow assets like USDC using your supplied cbBTC as collateral. You pay interest on what you borrow, and repaying it frees your collateral again.
borrow.b1: Your borrow limit is only a fraction of your collateral value — borrow conservatively (less).
borrow.b2: The closer your Health gets to 1.0, the riskier it is. It's shown by color on screen.
borrow.b3: If your collateral (cbBTC) price falls below the 'liquidation price', your position can be liquidated.
borrow.b4: Repay what you borrowed to withdraw your cbBTC collateral again.

risk.title: Risk note
risk.body: Supplying only carries no liquidation risk. If you later use borrowing (collateral loans), market moves can trigger liquidation — at that point, always check the health and liquidation price shown on screen.

lendingGuide.infographic1: Self-custody flow: your wallet → your signature (Seed Vault) → Kamino contract (the app never holds funds)
lendingGuide.infographic2: Transparency: public on-chain records · no backend · open source
lendingGuide.infographic3: Collateral loans & liquidation: cbBTC collateral → borrow USDC → health gauge (safe·caution·danger). Liquidated if price drops below the liquidation price
lendingGuide.infographic4: Withdraw: your supply in Kamino → cbBTC back to your wallet (all or part, anytime)
